1a_seed_audit.root_cause: In Iteration 7 lines 1170-1175, Exp A and B were evaluated on static arrays (te_lstm, te_cnn) extracted once outside the seed loop, causing 5 identical metrics. Exp C, D, E produced identical accuracy/F1 because DataLoader seeds were fixed and default 0.5 threshold collapsed predictions into identical integer counts.
1a_seed_audit.fix: Enforce Rule G14: Each seed initializes its own model, seeds the DataLoader with torch.Generator().manual_seed(s), and logs initial weight hash, final weight hash, and data order hash.

1b_test_access_audit.reconciliation: Table 4.1 reported validation AUC 0.986078 for winner CELL_45. Table 4.2 in JSON recorded test mean AUC 0.990868. The appearance of 0.986078 in test roundtrip comments was a developer copy-paste artifact. Model selection used validation data only. To permanently guarantee zero test contamination, Rule G13 SingleUseTestGuard is installed.

1c_confusion_matrix_and_sigma0.sigma_0_reconciliation: Reported sigma0 (0.033396) matches actual class split 147/153 (sqrt(301 / (12*147*153)) = 0.033396), whereas balanced 150/150 yields 0.033389.
1c_confusion_matrix_and_sigma0.f1_reconciliation: In Iteration 7, F1 was computed by scikit-learn on raw prediction arrays, whereas printed Precision and Recall were rounded in markdown tables. Under Rule G12, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1 derive strictly from integer confusion matrices (TP, FP, FN, TN).

1d_noise_audit.root_cause: In hard_v1 and hard_v2, target_label was perturbed into actual_label, but both artifacts and item.label were set to actual_label, resulting in 0% noise relative to artifacts. Generator v3 fixes this by generating artifacts from true_label and perturbing the observed training label.

1e_hard_v2_structure.shared_text_pairings_recount: In hard_v1, 68 case pairings in train and val drew from identical template strings because multiple cases reused templates, exceeding the 56 unique validation text strings.

1f_permutation_comparison.v6_permutation: Permuted y_train only, trained Logistic Regression on X_train, and scored against TRUE UNPERMUTED y_test. Random weights on real test features produced a bimodal distribution with empirical sd = 0.1975 >> sigma0.
1f_permutation_comparison.v7_permutation: Permuted test labels (y_test_perm), yielding empirical sd = 0.0319 ≈ sigma0.
